channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: The name now says what the place is: Rec and Park…
item.description: The name now says what the place is: Rec and Park calls P7 and P9 "open space parcels", and the official parcel code is kept in the name. No source read gives the parcel a proper name of its own. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project), body text: "The five open space parcels encompassing Mission Bay Commons, P7, and P9, will include a mix of active and passive programming.".
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project), body text: "The five open space parcels encompassing Mission Bay Commons, P7, and P9, will include a mix of active and passive programming."

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: The Rec and Park page gives an estimated schedule…
item.description: The Rec and Park page gives an estimated schedule of construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030; its background text says the remaining parks are anticipated to be complete by 2028. These are expected dates, not events. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: The timeline now shows the Future Parks…
item.description: The timeline now shows the Future Parks construction start as expected in 2028 and the opening as expected in 2030, both from the schedule table on Rec and Park's project page. The same page also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028', so the sources disagree and no month is shown. Source: Rec and Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: Rec and Park's October 2026 update says… (Oct 2026)
item.description: Rec and Park's October 2026 update says the developer is surveying the public on skate features and that the new skate and roll space is likely to go on parcels P9 and P7 (Oct 2026). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2026-10-05.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: The notes said no named, funded project had been…
item.description: The notes said no named, funded project had been found for P9. SF Rec & Park's Mission Bay Future Parks Project page names P7 and P9 as future active-recreation parks (skate park, pickleball courts, ballfield) fully funded through OCII, with construction to begin in late 2028, so that caveat was replaced and the page is now cited for the planned status and park use. The 'construction staging materials' description is now labelled an imagery observation, and an out-of-date note saying the neighbouring P8 record had been removed was corrected. Source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project).
item.source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P9: Design-team selection process under way… (Aug 2025)
item.description: Design-team selection process under way: per Rec and Park's August 2025 update, the developer (Mission Bay Development Group) released a request for qualifications in early August 2025 and expected to select a design team by mid-October (Aug 2025). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-08-26.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-08-26
